submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE was 0.0147% at Fe0.82Sb0.18. Sb-rich compositions containing the rutile FeSbO4-type phase (XRD peaks at Q≈1.90 and 2.47 near idx 19–29) gave about zero or slightly negative EQE at 2.1 eV illumination. That is consistent with 2.1 eV photons being absorbed mainly by Fe-rich, hematite-like material. Among the measured points, Fe-rich Sb-alloyed films were the only ones that showed photoactivity.
